unchangedOwnedFiles: electron/ipc.ts (registers every METHODS entry already; no change needed)

checks.result: pass: typecheck, vite build (488 kB JS / 44 kB CSS), dist-electron/main.cjs + preload.cjs contain the new methods

interfaces.compatibility: All new JarvisAPI methods are optional, so src/preview.ts and any older bridge still type-check. FullJarvisAPI = Required<JarvisAPI> is what the Electron preload and Backend implement. Callers must feature-check (api.planIntent?.) before use.

newMethods.getApiInfo(): -> {apiVersion: 2, features: ApiFeature[]}. Static, honest feature list. Unavailable: chat-streaming, chat-cancel, routines, region-capture, ocr, vision, automatic-input (by design).
newMethods.planIntent(command: string, options?: {u: -> IntentPlan. Wraps electron/services/intent.ts planIntent. For window-targeting ready plans, takes a read-only window snapshot (own PIDs excluded, skipped in safe launch) to pin a unique hwnd or return a clarification with candidates. useLocalModel=true only for commands the rules mark 'Unknown command': asks the loopback Ollama model via netGuard ('ollama' purpose) and parses the reply with parseModelPlan. Never the cloud. Never previews, confirms or executes.
newMethods.search(query: string, options?: {include: -> SearchResult[]. Wraps electron/services/search.ts searchState over the current store snapshot. Unknown or mistyped options are refused.
newMethods.listLocalModels(): -> LocalModelList {available, endpoint, models[{name,sizeBytes?,modifiedAt?,family?,parameterSize?,quantization?}], reason?}. GET <localEndpoint>/api/tags through netGuard, 2.5 s timeout, 2 MB / 200-entry bounds, malformed entries skipped. Never downloads models.

ipc.channels: jarvis:getApiInfo, jarvis:planIntent, jarvis:search, jarvis:listLocalModels added to METHODS/ARITY (electron/channels.ts).
ipc.argumentValidation: electron/ipcCore.ts ARG_SPECS + validateArgs(method, args): every method has a per-argument spec (string with min/max, plain object, boolean, enum, finite-number array). Runs after the sender check and before any handler; missing required args, wrong types, non-plain objects (Date, arrays) and oversized strings/arrays are rejected. executeAction's second argument must be a real boolean. undefined counts as an absent optional argument.
ipc.HandlerMap: Pick<Required<JarvisAPI>, MethodName>; main.ts withReminderRearm(backend) already iterates METHODS, so the new methods are registered without main.ts changes.

renderer.Assistant.tsx: Composer mode switch Chat | Desktop command. Command mode: Plan -> (ready plan or clarification candidates) Preview -> Approve… -> backend native confirmation -> outcome via actionOutcome. Exported pure helpers planCommand, planChoices, previewCommand, decideCommand, PLANNER_UNAVAILABLE, MAX_COMMAND_CHARS. Each helper makes one backend call; nothing auto-chains. Opt-in pref 'intentModelAssist' (enabled only when local-llm capability is available). Plan state is ephemeral, not written to chat history. Push-to-talk transcripts still land in the box for review only.
renderer.Computer.tsx: Optional 'Fill from a command' field (planIntent -> form via exported formFromRequest; candidates selectable; user still previews/approves). 'Screen reading' panel lists region capture / OCR / vision from getApiInfo as unavailable (exported SCREEN_FEATURES).

security: No change to native approval: BackendEnv.confirm remains the only approval; renderer 'approved' is still just a request; missing confirm denies (tested).
Plan and preview send no input (tested with injected native mocks); previews stay single use.
Model assist cannot override rule safety blocks (chains/click/oversize never reach the model) and is loopback-only via netGuard (tested: no https/cloud URL fetched).
Secret methods unchanged and write-only: no IPC method returns the cloud key (tested by method-name scan).
Strict IPC argument validation added for every method (tested: 31 malformed calls rejected with zero handler invocations).
dependencies: Uses existing services owned elsewhere: electron/services/intent.ts (planIntent, parseModelPlan, PLANNED_TYPES, MAX_COMMAND_CHARS), search.ts (searchState, SEARCH_LIMITS), chat.ts (ollamaChat), netGuard.ts, actions.ts, validation.ts (LIMITS).
If the intent owner changes the 'Unknown command' summary string, backend model-assist gating must be updated (covered by tests/autopilot-api.test.mjs).
Renderer MAX_COMMAND_CHARS (2200) mirrors services/intent.ts MAX_COMMAND_CHARS; a test asserts they match.

Captain: if a routines or models module lands, add its methods to contracts (optional), channels METHODS/ARITY, ipcCore ARG_SPECS, preload and backend, and flip the getApiInfo feature entry. The test 'every IPC method has an argument spec…' fails until all four are updated.
src/preview.ts (not owned) does not implement the optional v2 methods; the UI shows them as unavailable in browser preview. Its owner may add honest stubs later.
limitations: Chat is not streamed and cannot be cancelled: the backend only returns complete replies, so no streamed state was added to the UI (getApiInfo reports both as unavailable).
Routines: no routines module exists in this worktree, so no routines API was invented; reported unavailable.
Region capture, OCR and vision are not implemented anywhere; shown as unavailable, never simulated.
Planner window snapshot returns matching window titles as clarification candidates without an activity-log entry (read-only; same data list-windows already exposes).
listLocalModels reads the full loopback response body before applying the 2 MB bound.
Model-assist plan quality depends on the user's local model; no live Ollama run was performed in this session (fetch mocked in tests).
Live UI check in the AO browser panel was not possible: browser runtime reported BROWSER_RUNTIME_RECONNECTING. UI verified by typecheck, production build and helper tests only.
No Electron runtime/smoke run in this worktree (npm ci --ignore-scripts installs no Electron binary).
